cards.h1: Nobody tells you what to ask a venue

cards.text: Hi, planning a hens for 12 on Sat 18 Oct. Do you take groups that size?

cards.title: Then ask these three
rows: Do we pre-order food, or order on the day?
When do you need final numbers?

cards.text: The final numbers date. After it, anyone who drops out is still costed in.
Five answers and you can price the whole day per head.

cards.title: Frolic asks the right questions
cards.sub: Hens and bucks planning, start to finish
